marketDirection.headline: Indian market is advancing today.

reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed +0.58% at 25,291, above its 20-DMA, above the 50-DMA (rising), above the 200-DMA.
The index is up 1.2% over the last five sessions — uptrend structure intact.
Market breadth is mixed — 49.7% of scanned NSE stocks advancing, 45.3% above their 50-DMA.
High-volume promoter/PE overhang clearance at Rs 219 without price degradation sets up a strong floor for a continuation breakout above the 228 handle.
Investment-grade balance sheet re-rating provides strong institutional support as the stock attempts to clear overhead supply at the 2,750-2,780 resistance shelf.

marketDirection.disclaimer: A rules-based read of index price, market breadth and headline flow — not a forecast or trading advice.

marketSummary: The Nifty 50 closed higher for a second consecutive session at 25,387.40 (+0.38%), while Bank Nifty printed a fresh record high at 62,273.25 (+1.13%), propelled by sustained institutional liquidity and softening global crude prices. Market breadth remained selective with strong institutional rotation into banking, real estate, and capital goods, while IT (-0.90%) witnessed defensive trimming ahead of major global tech earnings. Cumulative FII inflows for November topped $9.5 billion, providing strong support at key moving average clusters.
dailyFocus: High-volume base breakouts and flag contractions in private/PSU banking, capital goods, and defence suppliers; tracking institutional absorption around multi-week consolidation pivots.

sectors.name: Nifty Bank / Financial Services
sectors.reason: Bank Nifty registered fresh all-time highs above 62,200 with broad-based participation from large-cap private lenders and PSU banks, supported by heavy FII block absorption and moderating bond yields.
catalysts: Sustained domestic deposit stability and expanding credit demand
risks: Potential sector rotation on global interest rate commentary

sectors.name: Nifty Realty
sectors.reason: Realty posted strong relative momentum, up nearly 1.94% on robust pre-sales registration disclosures and sustained institutional demand in tier-1 commercial and residential developers.
catalysts: Q3 festive pre-sales strength across key metros
Stable borrowing costs encouraging developer balance sheet expansion
risks: Stretched valuations after sharp multi-week advance

sectors.name: Defence & Aerospace
sectors.reason: Defence counters are completing multi-week consolidation bases following fresh Ministry of Defence contract announcements, expanding export inquiries, and accelerating engine delivery schedules.
catalysts: Cabinet Committee on Security approvals and MoD pipeline execution
Subsystem delivery ramp-ups for fighter aircraft and naval vessel refits
risks: Execution slippages from international component supply chains
Margin contraction in initial tranches of fixed-price contracts

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Power Transmission
sectors.reason: Sustained transmission capex awards and sub-station electrification tenders are driving steady accumulation in industrial equipment manufacturers trading near upper range resistance levels.
catalysts: Grid capacity expansion mandates across green energy corridors
Semiconductor and high-voltage transformer capex commercialization
risks: Elevated raw material and copper pricing
High forward earnings multiples demanding flawless quarterly conversion

sectors.name: Auto & Mobility
sectors.reason: Performance remains sharply bifurcated: two-wheeler premium names and commercial vehicle manufacturers are showing volume expansion, while luxury passenger vehicle segments face overseas margin headwind resets.
catalysts: Strong festive despatches in premium motorcycles
risks: Margin guidance downgrades in European luxury subsidiaries
Intensified discount pressure in mass-market passenger vehicles

news.headline: Ribbit Capital Offloads 8.7 Crore Shares in Rs 1,905 Crore Block Deal; Institutional Heavyweights Absorb
news.summary: Venture capital investor Ribbit Capital sold 8.7 crore shares (1.4% equity) of Billionbrains Garage Ventures (Groww) at an average price of Rs 219 per share in a pre-open block window on November 17, 2026. The transaction, valued at Rs 1,905.3 crore, was absorbed by institutions including BlackRock, Morgan Stanley Asia, Societe Generale, and Kotak MF.
news.impact: High-volume promoter/PE overhang clearance at Rs 219 without price degradation sets up a strong floor for a continuation breakout above the 228 handle.

news.headline: ICRA Upgrades Long-Term Credit Rating to ICRA AA (Stable) for Over Rs 16,500 Cr Bank Lines
news.summary: In an official exchange disclosure on November 17, 2026, Adani Enterprises announced that rating agency ICRA upgraded its long-term credit rating to ICRA AA with a Stable outlook from ICRA AA- across Rs 16,505 crore of bank facilities and non-convertible debentures, citing sustained deleveraging and robust core operational cash flows.
news.impact: Investment-grade balance sheet re-rating provides strong institutional support as the stock attempts to clear overhead supply at the 2,750-2,780 resistance shelf.

news.headline: Eicher Motors Surges on 1.8x Volume with Heavy Call Build-Up at Rs 7,800 Strike
news.summary: Shares of Eicher Motors advanced over 3% to settle above Rs 7,820 on Tuesday with volume running 1.8x above its 20-day average. Derivatives data showed heavy call accumulation concentrated at the Rs 7,800 and Rs 8,000 strikes ahead of monthly expiry, following post-earnings brokerage reviews highlighting resilient Royal Enfield order books.
news.impact: Decisive volume breakout above 7,750 triggers an ascending cup-style pattern targeting the psychological 8,000 mark.

news.headline: IAF Confirms Induction of First LCA Tejas Mk1A Squadron; AMCA Prototype Decision Imminent
news.summary: The Indian Air Force confirmed that deliveries for the first operational LCA Tejas Mk1A squadron will commence by March 2027 with initial unit handovers scheduled ahead of Aero India, aided by ongoing F404 engine shipments from GE Aerospace. Additionally, the Defence Ministry confirmed that the prototype manufacturer for the AMCA stealth fighter program will be chosen within four weeks.
news.impact: Clearer delivery and billing timelines ease execution overhangs, aiding HAL's attempt to build a higher swing low near the 4,800-4,850 zone.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Bags Additional Rs 619 Crore Orders for Drones and Electro-Optics
news.summary: Navratna defence PSU Bharat Electronics Limited confirmed via stock exchange filings that it has secured additional contracts worth Rs 619 crore spanning communications equipment, drones, electro-optics, and upgrade services, building upon its previous order inflow and solidifying its FY27 order guidance.
news.impact: Persistent order accretion keeps the stock supported above its 395-400 base pivot as volume builds for a potential range breakout.

news.headline: Ministry of Defence Inks Rs 498.58 Crore INS Betwa Refit Contract with Cochin Shipyard
news.summary: The Ministry of Defence sealed a formal contract worth Rs 498.58 crore with Cochin Shipyard for the comprehensive refit and re-powering of guided-missile frigate INS Betwa. The two-year execution scope includes diesel engine conversion and modern weapon suite integration, offering fresh revenue visibility to offset recent Q2 margin contraction.
news.impact: Substantial ship-repair order inflow provides fundamental cushion as price tests the lower boundary of its multi-month basing channel near 1,140-1,180.

news.headline: FII Inflows Cross $9.5 Billion in November as Nifty Rebounds to 25,387 and Bank Nifty Sets Record High
news.summary: Foreign institutional investors have injected more than $9.5 billion (approx. Rs 84,000 crore) into Indian equities in November 2026, offsetting global tech weakness and pushing BSE aggregate market capitalization above Rs 510 lakh crore as softening crude oil prices improve India's macroeconomic balance.
news.impact: Broad liquidity backstop creates high-probability conditions for continuation swing setups and reduces failure rates on breakout pullbacks.

news.headline: Jaguar Land Rover Trims Full-Year Operating Margin Guidance to 2-3% Amid Cash-Flow Pressures
news.summary: Tata Motors faced divergent moves across segments as luxury subsidiary Jaguar Land Rover trimmed its full-year adjusted EBIT margin forecast from 4% down to 2-3%, citing European geopolitical headwinds and an expected full-year free cash outflow of £1.25 billion, even as Indian passenger vehicle deliveries set a record 10-month high.
news.impact: JLR margin reset introduces supply overhang, keeping the stock vulnerable to false breakout attempts near key moving average clusters.

news.headline: Bahram Vakil Takes Charge as Chairman as Trent Consolidates After 1,000th Zudio Milestone
news.summary: Following Noel Tata's transition to Chairman Emeritus on November 11, Bahram Vakil formally assumed the role of Chairman of Trent on November 12, 2026. The retail powerhouse's Q2 revenue expanded 22% YoY to Rs 5,873 crore alongside the milestone opening of its 1,000th Zudio outlet, though the stock has entered a sideways digestion phase after recent brokerage valuation reviews.
news.impact: Leadership transition stabilizes governance as the stock builds a high-tight consolidation flag above the 3,150 support zone.

news.headline: CG Power Ramps Sehore Transformer Facility with Order Book Standing at Elevated Rs 23,600 Cr
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions continues operational scale-up following the commissioning of its Sehore power transformer plant, supported by an aggregate order backlog exceeding Rs 23,600 crore and recent board approvals for Rs 393 crore in switchgear and transformer capacity expansions across key manufacturing nodes.
news.impact: Consistent execution milestones keep the intermediate base intact near 810-830, awaiting a high-volume trigger to challenge lifetime highs.
